purpose: Test whether the frozen MAIN40 40/40 A0 result remains A0 under deliberately weaker comparison representations when the same direct-preservation and least-reconstruction semantics are applied.
scientific_boundary: This is a comparator closure control over the frozen MAIN40 representation, not a re-adjudication of source truth.
The certified MAIN40 outcomes remain immutable: A0=40, A1=0, A2=0 under the full frozen working basis.
Source-defined mechanisms are retained exactly; comparator arms may only change which source distinctions remain first-class at the comparison representation.
No population/prevalence inference, universal minimality claim, or non-encodability theorem is licensed.

least_lift_semantics.A0: All source-required preserved distinctions remain directly available in the comparator representation using source-defined mechanisms only; no reconstruction-added preservation structure.
least_lift_semantics.A1: A0 fails, but every lost source-required distinction can be re-exposed using only reconstruction-added stateless typed boundary/interface/guard/criterion/observation/sequencing structure whose content is already source-defined.
least_lift_semantics.A2: A1 fails and fidelity requires reconstruction-added load-bearing persistent/stateful preservation structure.
least_lift_semantics.nonlift: If fidelity cannot be restored within A2 without adding source semantics or hiding arbitrary model code, return explicit non-lift/underdetermination rather than promoting A2.

stateless_restoration_contract.Pi: typed boundary exposure over an already source-defined partition
stateless_restoration_contract.C: stateless admissibility/constraint guard exposing an already source-defined constraint
stateless_restoration_contract.Q: stateless criterion/orientation exposure over an already source-defined criterion
stateless_restoration_contract.P: typed probe/intervention/interface exposure over an already source-defined port or intervention
stateless_restoration_contract.rho/O: typed observation/output exposure over an already source-defined readout
stateless_restoration_contract.T: stateless explicit sequencing/execution-order edge over already source-defined order

prohibited_restorations: inventing a new scientific variable, mechanism, objective, partition, criterion, or state
encoding omitted distinctions inside opaque generic model code or universal interpreters
using historical construct labels as comparison features
changing the source-defined mechanisms or the frozen paper identity/provenance
counting notation-only relabeling as a scientific A1 witness unless it is load-bearing for the declared preservation test
rowwise_algorithm: Read only Grammar_roles_used and immutable metadata from the frozen M7 matrix; do not reread sources.
For an arm, preservation debt is the set difference Grammar_roles_used minus arm.roles.
If preservation debt is empty, classify comparator closure as A0.
If every debt role is in stateless_restoration_contract, classify comparator closure as A1 and record the exact restoration types.
If a debt role requires a new persistent/history-bearing object after source-defined state is retained, classify A2.
Otherwise return NONLIFT_OR_UNDERDETERMINED; do not force a class.
aggregate_outputs: exact per-paper preservation debt and restoration class
whether any weaker comparator also obtains 40/40 A0
whether the full-basis 40/40 A0 result is basis-sensitive under this direct-preservation criterion
interpretation_rule: A failure of weaker comparators to remain A0 supports discriminative validity only relative to the declared direct-preservation criterion. It does not show that weaker formalisms lack generic encoding power or that the full role inventory is a unique ontology.

prefreeze_disclosure.consequence: Some closure-control outcomes are logically anticipatable from the frozen matrix. This is therefore a predeclared deterministic control, not a blinded empirical experiment.
